item.title: Fatima Zahra El Mansouri, la primera mujer elegida primera ministra de Marruecos
item.description: Por primera vez, una mujer será la primera ministra de Marruecos. Se trata de Fátima Zahra el Mansouri (Marrakech, 1976) , exministra de Vivienda y coordinadora general del grupo de centroderecha Partido de Autenticidad y Modernidad (PAM), formación que ganó las pasadas elecciones del 23 de septiembre. Un nombramiento que ha pillado por sorpresa después de que en las últimas semanas sonara con más fuerza para sustituir a Aziz Ajanuch el que ahora es presidente de la Federación de Fútbol de Marruecos, Fouzi Lekjaa.Según un comunicado del Palacio Real, publicado por la agencia oficial marroquí… Publicado también por: ABC España - Internacional, El Mundo - Internacional. item.description: Tras meses de tensiones acumuladas, la unión de siete grupos armados contra el primer ministro del Gobierno de Etiopía, Abiy Ahmed , ha hecho estallar un nuevo conflicto civil en el norte del país. item.description: En el primer día de su visita de Estado a España, el presidente Emmanuel Macron pidió el martes 29 de septiembre una inversión masiva para una "Europa más fuerte" y para "recuperar el control" de las redes sociales y la inteligencia artificial, a las que consideró responsables del "cansancio democrático". item.title: Trump says AI companies sign voluntary accord on safety controls
item.description: President Donald Trump and leaders of major artificial intelligence companies signed a voluntary accord Tuesday to strengthen safety reviews as the technology faces growing public concern. The agreement calls for internal controls, independent audits and board oversight, while Trump rejected calls for government restrictions and urged rapid AI development. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Morocco’s king appoints El Mansouri as first woman prime minister
item.description: King Mohammed VI appointed Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri on Tuesday as Morocco’s first woman prime minister after her liberal-centrist party came out on top in a September 23 parliamentary election, the royal palace said. The king asked El Mansouri to form a new government, the palace said in a ‌statement. El Mansouri’s Authenticity and Modernity Party (PAM) was created in 2008 by an adviser to the king and has since positioned itself as a counterweight to the Islamist Justice and Development Party... Publicado también por: The Washington Post - World, The Jerusalem Post - International, France 24 - English. Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Xi-Trump summit drew Chinese CEOs. So why couldn’t they get a seat at the table?
item.description: As American billionaires gathered at the White House to honour Chinese President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan last Thursday, a group of Chinese business leaders spent the evening on the sidelines. They had travelled to the US capital to join the state dinner. But their invitations never arrived. For weeks, their participation was the subject of intense discussion between Washington and Beijing. While it was under consideration until the summit’s final hours, they were ultimately excluded... item.title: Trump says doesn't want to work with China on AI safety
item.description: US President Donald Trump discussed AI development with dozens of tech bosses at the White House. Ahead of his "superintelligence" luncheon, Trump launched a new AI-powered website for government services vowing not to stifle the technology's growth. He also said he didn't want to work with Chinese President Xi Jinping on AI oversight. Plus, dozens of dogs were rescued from a breeding farm in South Korea as the country prepares for a complete phaseout of the dog meat industry. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Public service announcement or Donald Trump propaganda?
item.description: The White House calls them public service announcements - like those used in past administrations. Almost everyone else doesn't agree, with three taxpayer-funded advertisements that glorify President Donald Trump drawing criticism from across the partisan divide. Legal experts say the ads violate federal laws on government propaganda, as France 24's Emerald Maxwell explains in this edition of Truth or Fake. Fuente: France 24 - English.

But he acknowledged that economic constraints make delivering his sweeping plans a big political risk. “Small things will not get us through what are difficult times,” Burnham said in a tough-love speech to the centre-left Labour Party’s annual... item.title: ¿Desaprobación de Trump influye en la ventaja del Partido Demócrata para las 'midterms'?
item.description: A cinco semanas de las elecciones de medio término en Estados Unidos, el panorama no se ve muy favorecedor para el Partido Republicano. Las contradicciones del presidente Donald Trump, el incumplimiento de promesas y la falta de resultados impactantes en la vida de los ciudadanos han impactado en la imagen del mandatario y de su bancada política, evidenciando en las encuestas una clara ventaja para el Partido Demócrata. En el Invitad@ del día analizamos el panorama de las 'midterms' con Carlos Manuel Indacochea, analista político y sociólogo. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

Los choques se producen mientras los sindicatos organizan una jornada de manifestaciones contra un recorte de gastos elaborado por el Gobierno del primer ministro, Sébastien Lecornu, quien encara una situación compleja. item.description: PM accepts some of his plan could be difficult and admits he ‘may pay a political price’ Analysis: PM’s promises will take time to come good Key takeaways from Burnham’s conference speech Andy Burnham has staked his future on a gamble that the public will back radical progressive policies on social care, electoral reform and Europe, telling voters that his agenda will break the mould of the last 40 years and “allow us to rise again”. In a deeply personal speech at Labour’s conference, Burnham began building his next general election manifesto, acknowledging that he may end up paying the price… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: EE. UU. amplía proceso judicial por el asesinato del presidente haitiano Jovenel Moïse: ¿habrá un giro en el caso?
item.description: La violencia en Haití no cesa. Al menos 11 personas murieron en la región central de Artibonite, Haití, a manos de miembros de bandas tras una operación de seguridad letal, según informó el alcalde local. Entretanto, Estados Unidos amplió considerablemente el proceso judicial relacionado con el asesinato del presidente haitiano Jovenel Moïse, ocurrido en 2021. ¿Qué cambia ahora? Lo desciframos. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Burnham’s emotional solo act had Labour in raptures – but his promises will take time to come good
item.description: PM’s speech, written almost entirely alone, was full of radicalism but his biggest plans will have to wait until after the next election Key takeaways from Andy Burnham’s conference speech Hope Again is the conference slogan. But what felt even more apt was Try Again. Just forget about the last two years, after the party won a historic majority but where the mood never matched the achievement. Now, as conference delegates and MPs filed out of the hall after Andy Burnham’s first speech as prime minister , it was close to euphoria. Where the hell have you been all our lives? What have we been… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: France's Le Pen defiant after top ally hit by antisemitism claims
item.description: French far-right presidential candidate Marine Le Pen on Tuesday vowed to hit back at allegations of antisemitism targeting her de-facto number two Jordan Bardella, which have punctured her buoyant campaign at a time she is riding high in the polls. item.title: 87 mil reproducciones · 2878 reacciones | #Eleição2026 - O ministro do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) Luiz Fux suspendeu nesta segunda-feira (28) os efeitos da decisão do ministro Flávio Dino que havia derrubado uma ordem do ministro André Mendonça, do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE), para remover publicações que associavam o candidato à Presidência Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) à retirada de Nossa Senhora Aparecida do posto de padroeira do Brasil. Com a decisão, Fux restabeleceu, provisoriamente, as determinações do ministro André Mendonça, do TSE, que haviam mandado retirar do ar conteúdos considerados desinformativos sobre o tema, incluindo uma publicação do humorista Antonio Tabet. A decisão de Dino, tomada no domingo (27), havia permitido o restabelecimento do post de Tabet e de outras publicações removidas pelo mesmo fundamento. O ministro argumentou que a postagem não citava nominalmente Flávio Bolsonaro e que a medida era necessária para proteger a liberdade de expressão. Ao analisar um pedido da defesa de Flávio Bolsonaro, Fux determinou a sustação de todos os efeitos da decisão de Dino até que o plenário do STF analise o caso. Segundo o ministro, o tema deve ser examinado pelo colegiado diante dos impactos sobre a Justiça Eleitoral e sobre a disputa presidencial em curso. Na decisão, Fux afirma que não está decidido se a publicação de Antonio Tabet é ou não protegida pela liberdade de expressão, nem se a determinação do TSE foi correta. Segundo ele, essas questões deverão ser analisadas pelas instâncias competentes e pelos colegiados envolvidos. ➡️ O ministro também argumentou que a decisão de Dino suspendeu uma tutela concedida pela Justiça Eleitoral às vésperas do primeiro turno e permitiu a circulação de conteúdos que o TSE considerou baseados em uma informação sem respaldo nos fatos. Fux determinou ainda que as plataformas digitais interrompam qualquer medida de execução da decisão de Dino e restabeleçam, em até 24 horas, a situação anterior, seguindo as ordens expedidas pelo TSE. item.description: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Tehran expects Washington to respond to its proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday.
